policy_name: PRIN – Projects of Relevant National Interest
historical_evidence: MUR historical series reports annual funding 2007-2022; intermittent calls and funding volatility
PNRR_relationship: Pre-existing instrument; 2022 PRIN call includes both national and PNRR funding streams; isolate them
source_note: MUR table 2007-2022; do not treat annual band allocation as annual performed R&D expenditure

policy_name: Fondo per l'innovazione tecnologica (FIT) / Fondo per la crescita sostenibile (FCS)
R&D_relevance: Mixed; selected calls directly fund R&D
historical_evidence: FCS replaced FIT in the 2012 incentive reform; 2013 interministerial decree set priorities and aid forms
PNRR_relationship: Pre-existing national instrument; check specific calls and national co-financing vs PNRR
source_note: FCS supports R&D, production structure and internationalisation; only R&D calls and eligible costs enter R&D panel

policy_name: FCS regional programme agreements for R&D projects
R&D_relevance: Direct R&D projects, mixed by agreement
historical_evidence: Initial EUR 80m allocation; regional co-financing at least 10% of public cost
PNRR_relationship: Potential overlap with PNRR MIMIT instruments; trace beneficiary/project ID
source_note: DM 1 April 2015; replaced by Accordi per l'innovazione regime after DM 24 May 2017

R&D_relevance: Direct R&D projects, eligible project costs
historical_evidence: Revised framework under FCS; current programme continues through later calls
PNRR_relationship: PNRR M4C2 I2.2bis is an additional specific tranche; distinguish previous national calls and funding
source_note: MIMIT page documents transition from regional programme agreements to Accordi per l'innovazione

historical_evidence: DL 145/2013 introduced credit from 2015; 2017 Budget Law extended to 2020 and strengthened rate
PNRR_relationship: Pre-existing national measure; not automatically PNRR financing
source_note: Incremental base over prior three-year average; reconstruct tax expenditure and underlying R&D separately

R&D_relevance: Direct R&D tax expenditure; distinguish from technology innovation and design credits
historical_evidence: Law 160/2019 introduced volume-based categories; MIMIT currently states R&D rate 20% to 2022 and 10% from 2023 to 2031
PNRR_relationship: Transition 4.0 bundles R&D and non-R&D tax credits; isolate R&D category and avoid double counting other subsidies
source_note: R&D, technological innovation, 4.0/green innovation and design have distinct eligibility and rates

R&D_relevance: Indirect/possible R&D via portfolio companies; not R&D by fund itself
historical_evidence: EUR 400m revised fund capital; direct and indirect equity, quasi-equity, debt and quasi-debt; report by channel required by T2 2026
PNRR_relationship: PNRR M4C2 I3.2; original MIMIT umbrella page EUR 300m is stale relative to updated project page EUR 400m
source_note: DM 11 March 2022; financial agreement 27 June 2022; revised agreement 10 June 2024

R&D_relevance: Indirect/possible R&D via portfolio companies; not R&D by fund itself
historical_evidence: EUR 250m fund capital; direct and indirect equity, quasi-equity, debt and quasi-debt; report by channel required
source_note: DM 3 March 2022; financial agreement 27 June 2022; revised agreement 10 June 2024

policy_name: Law 193/2024 Article 33 – institutional investment in VC funds
R&D_relevance: Enabling/crowding-in channel; not direct R&D spending
historical_evidence: Minimum share of qualifying investment basket directed to venture-capital funds; thresholds reported as 3% 2025, 5% 2026, 10% from 2027, subject to amendments/interpretation
PNRR_relationship: Separate reform-induced private VC commitments from PNRR fund capital; do not convert statutory thresholds into R&D
source_note: Later DL 95/2025 provisions clarify qualifying commitments and indirect VC investment; check consolidated text before operational compliance calculation

policy_name: Law 162/2024 – startups and innovative SMEs (Scaleup Act)
R&D_relevance: Enabling/indirect; business creation not equivalent to R&D
historical_evidence: Framework to promote creation and development of startups and innovative SMEs
PNRR_relationship: Separate from RRF measures and estimate effects on company creation, VC and R&D only with outcomes
source_note: Add to enabling reform register; do not count startup births as R&D

policy_name: R&D tax credit – incremental (2015–2019) and volume-based (2020 onward)
R&D_relevance: Direct R&D tax expenditure; 2020 onward R&D&I grouping includes technological innovation and design in some published aggregates
historical_evidence: Istat 2015-2020 analysis; MEF/Bank of Italy/MIMIT tax-return evaluation reports accrued R&D&I credits for 2020-2022
PNRR_relationship: Pre-existing national instrument; distinguish from PNRR and do not treat tax credits as PNRR expenditure
source_note: Separate R&D from innovation/design; tax credit accrual, tax offset and R&D performance are different time concepts. Initial evidence dataset contains exact corporate R&D&I amounts 2020-22 and indicative all-entity chart estimates; no pure R&D annual series yet.
